第十章 你们想残废吗
“这怎么可能？”蛮牛瞪大了眼睛，心中暗暗猜测着，乾劲其实在刚才的几次掰腕子比拼中，也都偷偷用上了斗劲，只是他的收放速度太快，令人无法察觉到？
蛮牛还记得，罗德里格斯老师曾经说过，当对斗劲运用到得心应手的地步时，确实可以瞬间收发斗劲瞒过对手，只是乾劲可以做到斗劲上得心应手了？这不可能吧？罗德里格斯老师曾经说过，除非成为拥有十级斗劲的十级战士，不然不可能做到那种程度。
十级战士？蛮牛摇头，罗德里格斯老师才是五级战士，乾劲才入学不到一年，就算他再怎么有前途，也不可能超过老师才对。
“再比一次。我不相信，我会输给你！”蛮牛深吸着气，眼珠子里多了几条血丝，如果今天就让乾劲这样离开，身为级部第三蛮力的头衔，也就要彻底丢失了。
还比？乾劲抬手晃动着手腕表示没兴趣，这次意外的比试已经得到了答案结果，自己更想早点买好床单回宿舍，去戴着那个古怪的帽子睡觉，进入那个什么虚拟游戏中进行训练。
“不比？”蛮牛起身三个大步超过乾劲，硕壮的身体在通向出口的道路上一横，面带着几分凶相：“今天你不比，就别想从这里离开。”
几名战士系一年二班的学院，也纷纷跳下床铺，站在了蛮牛的身旁。作为战士，鲁迪凭借着一身蛮力，也算是一年二班的骄傲之一，今天如果让乾劲带着胜利者的头衔离开，那对二班来说也算是集体抹黑的一种情况。
乾劲看着堵在门口的几名战士学员，目光最后定在了蛮牛的身上冷笑连连，本以为这个看起来有些粗犷的同学性格很是豪迈，没想到竟然输都输不起！作为战士，生在这天地间，输就要输的起！敢认，才算是男人！
罗林一旁偷偷看着乾劲的脸色，悄悄的将几名一班的同学往身后拽了拽，乾劲可是公认的级部实战前十名，虽然他没有像其他九人一样，为了争夺排名相互约战，就为了能在排名上更靠前一点，但没人相信如今年级实战排名顺位第十的乾劲，就真的实战第十了。
比起其他人，罗林更加了解乾劲的实力，别看蛮牛身高强壮，还有其他几名同学帮忙，真惹急了乾劲，恐怕在他倒地不起之前，这些人也都要陪着他一起去医院休息一段时间。
“你们，想残废？”乾劲的面色稍稍下沉：“都忘记凯萨斯了？”
凯萨斯，这个名字像是夏天突然落下的大雪，鲁迪几人脑海中划过了当日乾劲出手时的场景，身体不由的齐齐打了一个寒颤。
鲁迪几人交换着为难的眼神，如果之前让开那还好说，现在让开就是摆明了被乾劲几句话给震慑了，事情传出去还怎么在奥克兰学校继续待下去？
不能让！鲁迪的眼睛变得锐利起来，注意力全部转移到罗林腰间的钱袋上，那里可放着大把的铜板，就这么让乾劲给带走了，实在让人无法忍受。
“你要真的不想比也行，只要你让他把钱袋子放下，不然……”
乾劲眉角高高的翘起，将两只衣服袖子撸起，露出那还算强健的手臂，抬手一掌击在身边的木桌上：“不然？不然怎样？你还想打劫我不成？”
砰！年久失修的木桌，结结实实挨了乾劲全力一掌，左右摇晃了数下，突然哗啦一声变成了一地的碎木头，木板砸落在地面激起微微一阵尘土。
安静的房间，几块散架的木头，在地面上轻轻跳动，发出微弱的碰撞之声，撞击在鲁迪等人心中好似比武场上的战鼓，每一次碰撞都深深震撼着他们的心房。
一掌拍散了木桌！虽然这是一张年久失修，平日里碰一下就会吱嘎吱嘎响的木桌，但也绝对没有弱到随便找个人拍一掌，就能将它拍散地步。

鲁迪很清楚，自己全力一掌绝对无法将木桌拍散，如果说刚刚还心存疑惑的话，那么显然乾劲的力道绝对不容许任何人质疑。
乾劲偷偷抽了一眼脚下散落的木桌，内心也是暗叫：那个什么虚拟游戏训练的也太有效果了吧？一掌就把桌子给拍散了？
“怎么？”乾劲踢了踢脚下的木块，目光扫视着堵住去路的几人，语带威胁之音说道：“你们也想像这木桌一样？”
刚刚还站在鲁迪身旁的几名同伴，一瞬间全部让向了出口两旁，速度之快令乾劲怀疑自己出手，是否真的可以打中他们。
站在离开房间必经之路中央位置的鲁迪，在看到刚刚的‘战友’集体叛逃之后，硬起昂然的把头一抬，刚想要说一句狠话，突然看到乾劲眼底凶光一闪，顿时以极快的速度，给他闪出了一条敞亮的去路。
乾劲是谁啊？鲁迪可没有忘记，奥克兰魔法与战士初级学院，一年级战士系十大高手表面排名第十的人，曾经动手轻易将凯萨斯打成重伤送进医院的人，听说昨天凯萨斯才刚刚康复出院回到学校。
乾劲看着闪到一旁的鲁迪轻轻摇头，本以为从掰腕子时的目光来判断，这蛮牛也还算是一名有胆气的战士，现在看来当时的判断是错误的，白白多给了他一次掰腕子证明自己的机会。
罗林手捂着腰间的钱袋子，率先跑到了宿舍门外，很是开心的看着正在向外走的同伴。
乾劲看到罗林那奸商的本性，很怀疑这位同宿舍的朋友进错了学校，真不该来这奥克兰魔法与战士初级学院，而是该去奥克兰商业学院才对。
罗林看着乾劲走出房间，连忙上前两步，堆起脸上那很有弹性的胖肉，笑容中带着一点谄媚的味道：“我就说嘛，我怎么会看错人？乾劲，你就是太不自信了。如果挑战本年级排名第一的达克，也一定可以赢的！”
“争排名？”乾劲冷笑了两声，抬手弹了罗林脑门一下：“你还能更幼稚点吗？为了一个没用的排名，让一大群人把我当做小丑一样看，看着我跟别人对打？”

Chapter 10 Do you want to be disabled?
"How is this possible?" Man Niu's eyes widened, and he secretly guessed in his heart that the fighting spirit was actually secretly used in the several arm-wrestling competitions just now, but his retracting and releasing speed was too fast for people to notice?
Manniu still remembers that Mr. Rodriguez once said that when you are very good at using fighting spirit, you can indeed send and receive fighting energy in an instant to hide it from your opponent. But can you become more comfortable with fighting spirit? This is impossible, right? Mr. Rodriguez once said that unless you become a level 10 warrior with level 10 fighting spirit, it is impossible to achieve that level.
Level 10 warrior? Man Niu shook his head. Mr. Rodriguez was only a fifth-level warrior, and he had only been in school for less than a year. No matter how promising he was, he could not surpass the teacher.
"Compete again. I don't believe that I will lose to you!" Man Niu took a deep breath, with a few bloodshot eyes in his eyes. If Gan Jin left like this today, his title as the third strongest man in the division would be completely lost.
Still better? Ganjin raised his hand and shook his wrist to show that he was not interested. The answer to this unexpected competition had already been obtained. He wanted to buy sheets and go back to the dormitory as soon as possible, wear that weird hat to sleep, and enter that virtual game for training.
"No competition?" Man Niu stood up and took three long strides to exceed his motivation. His strong body crossed the road leading to the exit, with a somewhat fierce look on his face: "If you don't compete today, don't even think about leaving here."
Several warriors from the first year and second class of the academy also jumped off the bed and stood beside Man Niu. As a warrior, Rudy is one of the prides of Class 1 and Class 2 with his brute strength. If Ganjin leaves with the title of winner today, it will be a collective discredit to Class 2.
Ganjin looked at the few warrior students blocking the door, and finally fixed his eyes on Manniu and sneered again and again. He thought that this rough-looking classmate had a very heroic character, but he didn't expect that he couldn't even afford to lose! As a warrior, born in this world, if you lose, you have to lose! If you dare to admit it, you are considered a man!
Luo Lin secretly looked at Gan Jin's face, and quietly pulled several classmates behind him. Gan Jin was recognized as one of the top ten in the class. Although he did not compete with each other for rankings like the other nine people, just to get higher in the rankings, no one believed that Gan Jin, who is currently ranked tenth in the grade, is actually tenth in actual combat.
Compared to others, Luo Lin knew the strength of Gan Jin better. Even though Man Niu was tall and strong, and had several other classmates helping him, Gan Jin was really anxious. I am afraid that these people would have to accompany him to the hospital to rest for a while before he fell to the ground.
"You guys want to be disabled?" Gan Zheng's face sank slightly: "Have you forgotten about Caesars?"
Kesas, this name is like the sudden heavy snowfall in summer. The scene when Rudy and others took action flashed through their minds, and their bodies couldn't help but shudder.
Rudy and the others exchanged embarrassed looks. If they had stepped aside before, it would have been okay. But if they stepped aside now, it was clear that they were shocked by the words of Qian Jin. How could they continue to stay at Auckland School if the news spread?
Can't let it go! Rudy's eyes became sharp, and his attention turned to the money bag on Luo Lin's waist. There were a lot of copper plates there. It was really unbearable to let his energy be taken away like this.
"It's okay if you really don't want to compete, as long as you let him put down his money bag, otherwise..."
The corners of his eyebrows were raised high, and he rolled up his sleeves to reveal his relatively strong arms. He raised his hand and hit the wooden table next to him: "Otherwise? What else? Do you still want to rob me?"
Bang! The wooden table, which had been in disrepair for a long time, received a strong slap from Gan Jin. It shook left and right a few times, and suddenly turned into pieces with a crash on the ground.Wood and planks fell to the ground, causing a slight burst of dust.
In the quiet room, a few pieces of broken wood beat gently on the ground, making a faint sound of collision. The impact in the hearts of Rudy and others was like war drums on the competition field. Every collision deeply shocked their hearts.
The wooden table was shattered with one palm! Although this is a wooden table that has been in disrepair for a long time and will creak when touched, it is definitely not so weak that a random person can slap it away.
Rudy knew very well that he would never be able to knock the wooden table apart with his full palm. If he was still doubtful just now, then it was obvious that the strength of his energy would not allow anyone to question it.
Ganjin secretly glanced at the wooden table scattered at his feet, and secretly shouted in his heart: Isn't that virtual game training too effective? Slap the table apart with one palm?
"What?" Ganjin kicked the wooden block under his feet, glanced at the people blocking the way, and said with a threatening tone: "Do you also want to be like this wooden table?"
The companions who were standing next to Rudy just now all gave way to both sides of the exit in an instant. The speed was so fast that Ganjin doubted whether he could really hit them.
Rudy, who was standing in the center of the only way out of the room, raised his head proudly after seeing his "comrades" defecting en masse. Just when he was about to say a harsh word, he suddenly saw a fierce light in Gan Jin's eyes, and he immediately opened a clear way for him at an extremely fast speed.
Who is the energy? Rudy has not forgotten that the man who was apparently ranked tenth among the top ten first-year warriors at Oakland Magic and Warrior Junior College was the man who easily beat Caesars to serious injuries and sent him to the hospital. I heard that Caesars had just recovered and been discharged from the hospital yesterday and returned to school.
Ganjin looked at Rudy who had stepped aside and shook his head slightly. He originally thought that judging from the look in his eyes during the arm-wrestling, this barbarian bull could be regarded as a courageous warrior. Now it seems that his judgment at that time was wrong. He was given an extra chance to prove himself by arm-wrestling.
Luo Lin held the money bag around his waist and ran out of the dormitory door first, looking happily at his companions who were walking out.
Gan Jin saw Luo Lin's profiteer nature and suspected that his friend in the same dormitory had entered the wrong school. He really shouldn't have gone to Oakland Magic and Warrior Junior College, but should have gone to Oakland Business College.
Luo Lin watched Gan Jin walk out of the room, took two steps forward quickly, piled up the elastic fat on his face, and smiled with a hint of flattery: "Let me tell you, how could I misjudge the person? Gan Jin, you are just too unconfident. If you challenge Dak, who is ranked first in this grade, you will definitely win!"
"Competing for ranking?" Gan Jin sneered twice and raised his hand to flick Luo Lin's forehead: "Can you be more childish? For a useless ranking, let a large group of people treat me like a clown and watch me fight with others?"
